name: mem_fs
description: Mount a memory image with MemProcFS and return what it exposes: the process list with parents and paths, and the file tree the ordinary tools can then read. Says plainly when MemProcFS is not on the host rather than implying the memory was examined.

mount.description: Where to mount it: a directory under your own work/<your id>/ (the rest of work/ is read-only in a VM)

list.description: A path inside the mount to list, e.g. 'sys/proc' (default: the process list)
